rest_base_url.description: Base URL path under which all REST endpoints will be available (e.g., /api). Must begin with '/' and not include the domain.

rest_endpoints.description: List of REST endpoints to expose via HTTP(S). Each entry defines a path, allowed methods, and handler module.

path.description: URL path for this endpoint, relative to `base_url` (e.g., /users). May include wildcards like /user/:id.

methods.description: List of allowed HTTP methods (case-insensitive; normalized to uppercase in config).

handler.description: Erlang module implementing this endpoint (must export rest/2 or rest/3 functions).

acl.description: Optional list of access control rules for this endpoint. If omitted, defaults to no restrictions.

user.description: JID or user pattern (e.g., admin@example.com, '*@admin.*'). Use '*' for any user.

access.description: Whether to allow or deny this user access.

rest_log_requests.description: Enable detailed logging of incoming REST requests (helpful for debugging; may affect performance).

rest_max_request_size.description: Maximum allowed HTTP request body size in bytes (1 MB default). Set to 0 for unlimited.

rest_request_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) allowed for request processing before returning HTTP 503.

rest_enable_cors.description: Enable Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) headers in HTTP responses to permit browser-based clients.

rest_cors_origins.description: List of allowed origins for CORS (e.g., ['https://myapp.example.com', 'http://localhost:3000']). Use ['*'] to allow all.

rest_cors_headers.description: List of HTTP headers allowed in CORS preflight requests and responses.
